issues.description: Reviewers report being logged out, locked out after a hack, or unable to switch accounts, and say support channels do not help resolve the problem.
issues.title: Account access, hacking, and logout problems

issues.description: Reviewers say the app logs them out or leaves them stuck offline with no way to go back online, and mention liked songs and shuffle behaving oddly.
issues.title: Unexpected logouts and offline lockouts

issues.description: Reviewers report being unable to log in, including through Facebook, even after resetting passwords or reinstalling the app.
issues.title: Cannot log in despite password resets

issues.description: Reviewers complain about frequent ads, including ads appearing for paying premium members, and about restrictions on free accounts.
issues.title: Ads still shown to premium or free users

issues.description: Reviewers report being charged unexpectedly after a free trial, having payments rejected, or struggling to get refunds.
issues.title: Unexpected charges and payment failures

issues.description: Reviewers feel the app has become paid-only or too costly for their country, and criticize limits that push them toward premium.
issues.title: Subscription now feels fully paid

issues.description: Reviewers say skips, repeats, queueing, lyrics and shuffle now require premium, which they find frustrating.
issues.title: Basic playback controls locked behind premium

issues.description: Reviewers say podcasts, album track lists and other features became premium-only or unskippable, making the free experience unusable.
issues.title: Features moved behind premium paywall

issues.description: Reviewers find the premium subscription too expensive and question whether it is worth paying, especially given artist payouts.
issues.title: Subscription price seen as too high

issues.description: Reviewers report that some songs or albums cannot be played, cover art is missing, and automated playlists feel repetitive.
issues.title: Tracks unavailable and poor recommendations

issues.description: Reviewers say lyrics have disappeared for many songs or cannot be shown in their preferred language.
issues.title: Lyrics missing or limited

issues.description: Reviewers say many songs and albums from other platforms or by well-known artists are unavailable on Spotify.
issues.title: Songs and albums missing from catalog

issues.description: Reviewers report podcasts disappearing or not being available in their region, and missing podcast categories.
issues.title: Podcasts missing or unavailable in some regions

issues.description: Reviewers say the recommendation features reappear after being turned off and that the redesigned home screen hides playlists and radios.
issues.title: Home screen recommendations unwanted and persistent

issues.description: Reviewers say search does not return all of an artist's songs, including features and covers, and that the new home screen makes finding music harder.
issues.title: Search misses songs and artists

issues.description: Reviewers report downloads disappearing or failing to play offline, and being unable to re-download music after updates.
issues.title: Downloaded music removed or cannot be downloaded

issues.description: Reviewers say their downloaded music and library are reset or deleted, and that they cannot move downloads to an SD card.
issues.title: Downloads and library reset unexpectedly

issues.description: Reviewers say offline mode is slow, with long load screens for downloaded albums and a laggy library.
issues.title: Slow loading in offline mode

issues.description: Reviewers say songs and podcasts were removed or censored due to political pressure, and they are angry and threatening to leave.
issues.title: Songs removed for political reasons

issues.description: Reviewers describe repeated glitches, unaddressed bugs, and the app not working for several days.
issues.title: Frequent bugs and app not working

issues.description: Reviewers express broad frustration with the app, calling it buggy, unworthy of payment, or simply hateful without naming a specific feature.
issues.title: Generally poor app experience and dissatisfaction

issues.description: Reviewers say the latest updates are disappointing, unhelpful, or poorly communicated, with some threatening to stop using or cancel the app.
issues.title: Disliked recent app updates overall

issues.description: Reviewers report that Spotify uses a large amount of battery, including in the background and when the app is barely used, such as when it keeps the phone awake for Spotify Connect.
issues.title: App drains phone battery excessively

issues.description: Reviewers report the app says there is no internet connection or that they are offline even when mobile data or Wi-Fi is working, preventing playback.
issues.title: False offline message on mobile data

issues.description: Reviewers report the app randomly freezing, crashing mid-song, restarting tracks, or failing to load content until it is force-stopped or the phone is rebooted.
issues.title: App crashes or locks up during playback

issues.description: Reviewers report problems such as audio desync on a watch, gapless playback not working on speakers or in the car, hidden songs playing on other devices, and unwanted autoplay in the car.
issues.title: Playback fails or desyncs across devices

issues.description: Reviewers report general playback glitches such as songs greyed out and unplayable, the app closing randomly, unexpected song skipping, and tracks resuming or continuing from the queue unexpectedly.
issues.title: Songs stop, skip, or close unexpectedly

issues.description: Reviewers report that podcasts stop unexpectedly, fail to load the latest episode, and do not resume from where they left off.
issues.title: Podcasts stop suddenly and lose place

issues.description: Reviewers report the volume automatically rising, streaming quality stuck at low, audio quality settings becoming unchangeable, and inconsistent volume levels such as for podcasts.
issues.title: Volume and audio quality problems

issues.description: Reviewers report that songs stop or pause on their own, sometimes after ads or after finishing a track, and sometimes switch to random devices, requiring an app restart to resume.
issues.title: Music pauses or stops unexpectedly

issues.description: Reviewers report the app being slow to load songs, needing multiple restarts after updates, quitting during playback, or failing to launch after a new update.
issues.title: Slow loading and failures after updates

issues.description: Reviewers report that songs will not play, the playback slider does not work, songs cannot be rewound or played fully, and the app starts playing unexpectedly after phone calls.
issues.title: Songs won't play or controls fail

issues.description: Reviewers mention customer support as either helpful or poor, with complaints about unanswered reports and slow responses, alongside concerns about stolen streams and the home screen design.
issues.title: Poor customer service responsiveness and issues

issues.description: Reviewers say ads play too frequently, sometimes after every song or two, and that the frequency increased after updates, making ads feel more prominent than music.
issues.title: Too many ads interrupting listening

issues.description: Reviewers report removed or changed features such as Car Mode, the add button, history removal, and the swipe-to-like gesture, along with unexpected reshuffling and inconsistent search results.
issues.title: Confusing changes to features and controls

issues.description: Reviewers dislike the redesigned TikTok-style home screen and layout, saying it is hard to browse, see, or find content such as daily mixes, and they ask for the old layout back.
issues.title: New interface layout hard to navigate

issues.description: Reviewers report being unable to add songs to playlists or view the queue, and say removing recently played albums and liked songs makes it harder to return to content.
issues.title: Playlist, queue, and recently played access problems

issues.description: Reviewers report that shuffle plays the same few songs from large playlists, the enhanced shuffle control is awkward to toggle, and they cannot skip to parts of songs.
issues.title: Shuffle repeats songs and skipping is limited

issues.description: Reviewers complain that recent updates added a TikTok-style screen, moved lyrics, removed the replay option, and introduced new bugs, prompting requests to revert them.
issues.title: Unwanted changes in recent updates
